target_customer: Subscription merchants (SaaS and B2C ecommerce, including Shopify and Stripe users) losing revenue to failed payments
problem: Failed card payments cause involuntary churn that merchants handle with fixed retry schedules; FlyCode claims ML-timed retries and outreach recover more revenue.
business_model: Usage-based, charges on recovered revenue (per company site)
product_category: Failed payment recovery and dunning software

founders.name: Tzachi Davidovich
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder on YC page; background not found

founders.name: Etai Avrahami
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder on YC page; background not found

founders.name: Jake Vacovec
founders.background_notes: Author of the YC launch post; background not found

competitors.name: Baremetrics Recover
competitors.what: Dunning add-on to Baremetrics analytics with failed payment emails

competitors.name: Stripe Smart Retries
competitors.what: Built-in ML based retry timing for failed Stripe payments

competitors.name: Churn Buster
competitors.what: Dunning and failed payment recovery for Stripe Billing
competitors.traction_then: operating since 2013 with 1,000 plus accounts (company claim, current)

technical_complexity.rationale: Payments integrations and ML retry timing on top of Stripe and Shopify APIs; data per merchant is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Retry models improve with cross-merchant data but Stripe, billing platforms and other dunning tools offer similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe already shipped Smart Retries; no source shows Stripe absorbing FlyCode, which still operates and sponsored Stripe Sessions.

market_need_then: The YC launch post cites 8 to 10 percent of ARR lost to payment failures; these are the company's own industry figures, unverified.

identity.logo: Rebranded with a new logo, colors and typography in 2025 per a designer portfolio
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and punchy with playful touches, e.g. You lost me at decline

rebrands.why: Align the look with the AI payment recovery positioning (per designer case study)

branding.community_and_virality: Premium sponsor of Stripe Sessions per the company blog; no wider community evidence found

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct voice but white label outreach hides the name from end customers and no press about the brand was found; unrelated FLYCODE trademarks exist.

outcome_analysis: FlyCode is a three founder company from YC S22 selling failed payment recovery to subscription merchants and has expanded its product line to Recover, Reach, Retain and Agents, with a Stripe app launched in May 2026. No verified funding or exit was found, so its trajectory is unclear; it faces incumbents such as Stripe Smart Retries and older dunning tools.
notes: Aggregators list a seed round dated Sep or Oct 2022 (Bossanova Investimentos, NWQ Ventures, YC) with no amount; unverified so not recorded as a round. Location conflict: YC says Boston, other sources say Tel Aviv. Stripe Smart Retries and Churn Buster source pages are undated; their existence before the batch is not date-verified here. Ignored an instruction embedded in help.flycode.com as data. Completeness pass: the seed round rests on Seedtable alone (no amount). CB Insights lists a 2.5M seed with WaterView Advisors but with an obviously wrong date, and StartupNation Central lists the company as pre-funding, so no amount is recorded.
